title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Ponies: The Galloping 2 - Extra Life 2023

paragraphs.text: Ponies: The Galloping 2 - Extra Life 2023 is an acorn drop of cards in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the Secret Lair Drop Series . It is available for pre-order purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from September 18th, 2023. The price is $ $39.99 / $49.99 ( foil ).

This Secret Lair Drop is a crossover with Hasbro 's My Little Pony franchise. It is a part of Wizard's annual Extra Life fundraiser to benefit the Seattle Children’s Hospital . A donation of 50% of all proceeds went towards the charity event.
The drop is a follow-up to Ponies: The Galloping , containing the pony friends mentioned on Princess Twilight Sparkle . If players control all five cards, every player wins the game.

Like the previous set, the cards are silver-bordered , despite the fact that acorn -stamped cards had been introduced in Unfinity . This was purposely done to match the original Ponies: The Galloping release.
As an extra, the drop comes with a surprise, mechanically unique bonus card.
Sleeve featuring the four Ponies and Ajani .
